Proposed fix: "...is determined, after applying tau, by Thurston geometrization and the Yekutieli rigid dualizing complex"; and delete or rewrite the Archimedean paragraph entirely. Separate (non-trap) findings, several verified: (1) KIND/PROSE MISMATCH — the .ts builder is conjecture({label: "conj:hoefsmit-scattering-pipeline"}) but the .md opens "**Proposition (conditional on ...)**" and then carries a full "*Proof.*" with a QED box. (2) DEPENDENCY MISMATCH — the banner conditions on conj:hyperbolic-volume-transcendence and rem:baryon-period-ratio, while uses[] declares a THIRD, unrelated conjecture (conj:geom-yekutieli-alignment) and neither banner item at all. (3) CIRCULAR NORMALISATION — Geom(K) is DEFINED as Vol(K)/hbar_q^2 for hyperbolic K, so the claim that the scalar "is fixed by requiring Geom(4_1) * hbar_q^2 = Vol(4_1)" is an identity that fixes nothing; and "the figure-eight knot defines q_0" is not the corpus convention (q_0 is pinned by CAL-2 through m_mu/m_e = Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2, i.e. by the LEPTON RATIO together with the 4_1 volume). (4) PURGED-WRAPPER SHAPE — AGENTS.md purged the opaque Geom_full(K) wrapper in favour of the explicit Vol(K)*rho(K)/hbar_q^2; "Geom(K)" is used here in exactly the opaque way, as an unexplained arrow in the pipeline. (5) WEIGHT-FAMILY COLLISION — this block writes J_K(q) = sum_lambda w_lambda chi_lambda(beta)/dim(lambda) with w_lambda = dim_q(lambda)^2/[k]_q!, while every sibling block in this batch (he4-two-row-dominance, hecke-generator-poly-reduction, hoefsmit-V21) writes tr_M = sum_lambda y_lambda chi^lambda with NO division by dim; the notation register warns that y_lambda, w_lambda and tilde-w_lambda are distinct at q != 1. (6) VERIFIED CORRECT: the convergence rate does check — [2]_q = 2.0108968667 and [2]_q^2 = 4.0437062085 at the proton pin, matching "approximately 4.04 per level", and this is also where prop:hecke-convergence-bound's undefined "r" comes from. (7) The closing "Archimedean specialisation" paragraph describes a "scattering-amplitude vanishing test ... over real inputs v_1, v_2, v_3" that DOES NOT EXIST anywhere in this block; together with the same boilerplate in prop:hecke-mass-trace ("the R->R realisation is acknowledged here") and prop:hecke-markov-transition ("What follows...", placed last so nothing follows), these three read as a sweep-inserted paragraph that should be audited as a class. (8) The italic "Formal asymptotic content" note ends "see Big-O via ordw and the body asymptotics catalog" — two cross-references with no labels or links.
